heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Vintage Camaro
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1], Forgo your next action: Avoid receiving a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Schematics Search Engine
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

rig.title: MS-todon
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

ice.title: Data Darts
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 3 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
